finalText:
All tests pass. The bug was in `pricing.js` — flat coupons are stored in USD but were being subtracted after currency conversion without being converted themselves. So a $10 coupon on a EUR order would subtract 10 EUR instead of the equivalent 9 EUR, making the total too low by exactly 1.

The fix converts the coupon amount to the target currency before subtracting it, so the math now happens correctly: the $10 coupon becomes 9 EUR, then gets subtracted from the 90 EUR total to give 81 EUR.
